identity.name: Web-Application Attack-Surface Enumeration & Injection Probing — Cortex ASM + NGFW (T1595.002 / T1595.003 / T1190)
identity.summary: External web enumeration and injection probing against the asm module's exposed nginx surface and the gocortexbrokenbank app on :9001. WhatWeb/CMSeeK fingerprint, Gobuster/Feroxbuster brute-force content, Nikto scans vulns, SQLmap/Commix probe injection. Cortex ASM discovers the surface while NGFW/NDR detects the scan+injection traffic, stitched into one exposure incident.
identity.description: Active reconnaissance of a public-facing web application is the most common precursor to exploitation: an attacker fingerprints the stack, brute-forces hidden content, scans for known web vulnerabilities, then probes the highest-value endpoints for injection. This scenario reproduces that full kill-chain stage against the intentionally exposed surface the asm Terraform module provisions — an internet-facing nginx host with directory listing and bait files (/admin, /config, /backup) plus the gocortexbrokenbank deliberately-vulnerable banking application on port 9001. The simulation runs seven web-recon tools in sequence: WhatWeb and CMSeeK fingerprint the technology stack and any CMS; Gobuster brute-forces directories and virtual hosts; Feroxbuster recursively discovers hidden content; Nikto runs a web-vulnerability scan; SQLmap probes the banking app's parameters for SQL injection; and Commix tests for OS-command injection. The dual-use tools (Gobuster, Feroxbuster, SQLmap, Commix) are gated behind the orchestrator's adapter-consent check, so the scenario refuses to launch without simulation_authorized. Detection spans two Cortex planes. Cortex ASM/Xpanse is the asset-discovery half: it inventories the exposed web service, fingerprints the technology stack, and surfaces the high-risk exposure (the directory-listing nginx and the vulnerable banking app) as exposure-management findings in asm_findings. The NGFW/NDR runtime half is the traffic-detection half: validation XQL runs against panw_ngfw_traffic_raw (the content-discovery URI fan-out from a single source) and panw_ngfw_threat_raw (the web-vulnerability-scan and injection threat signatures), and three BIOCs cover the content-discovery brute-force burst, the SQL-injection probe pattern, and the OS-command-injection probe pattern in inbound web requests. A correlation rule fuses the static ASM discovery findings with the live NGFW scan-and-injection detections into a single exposure-management incident a DC can present in the executive readout — proving that Cortex both discovers the exposed web surface and detects it being actively enumerated and exploited.

actors.name: Opportunistic web-application attackers and automated mass-scanning infrastructure

campaigns: Generic internet-facing web-application enumeration and injection

execution.framework_reference_id: SIM-ASM-004 — Web-application enumeration & injection probing via WhatWeb/Gobuster/Feroxbuster/Nikto/SQLmap/Commix/CMSeeK against the asm IaC exposed surface

prerequisites.description: asm IaC module applied so the exposed nginx host (:80/:443), the gocortexbrokenbank app (:9001), and the public S3 website are reachable.
Cortex ASM/Xpanse connected to the account and Cortex NGFW/NDR ingesting traffic+threat logs for the exposed subnet.
Launch consent (simulation_authorized) granted — the dual-use Gobuster/Feroxbuster/SQLmap/Commix adapters are gated by the orchestrator adapter-consent check.
prerequisites.check_command: echo "consent.simulation_authorized must be true at launch"

payload.code:
# Web-application attack-surface enumeration + injection probing against the
# asm IaC exposed surface. WhatWeb/CMSeeK/Gobuster/Feroxbuster/Nikto target the
# nginx surface; SQLmap/Commix target gocortexbrokenbank on :9001.
set -uo pipefail
TARGET="${ASM_TARGET_HOST:-127.0.0.1}"
whatweb -a 3 "http://${TARGET}/" || true
cmseek -u "http://${TARGET}/" --batch || true
gobuster dir -u "http://${TARGET}/" -w /usr/share/wordlists/dirb/common.txt -t 30 -q || true
feroxbuster -u "http://${TARGET}/" -d 2 -t 30 --silent || true
nikto -h "http://${TARGET}:9001" -Tuning 1234567890 || true
sqlmap -u "http://${TARGET}:9001/login.php?id=1" --batch --random-agent --level=2 --risk=1 || true
commix -u "http://${TARGET}:9001/ping.php?host=127.0.0.1" --batch || true

input_variables.name: ASM_TARGET_HOST
input_variables.description: Public IP / hostname of the asm-module exposed EC2 host.

expected_artifacts.description: High-volume inbound HTTP requests from a single source fanning out across many URIs/paths against the exposed nginx surface (content-discovery brute force).
Web-vulnerability-scan and injection threat signatures (SQLi / command-injection / scanner user-agents) inbound to the exposed web surface and the banking app on :9001.
expected_artifacts.expected_value: threat_category in (vulnerability, sql-injection, code-injection) and dst_port in (80, 9001)

expected_artifacts.description: Cortex ASM/Xpanse exposure-management findings enumerating the exposed web service, its technology fingerprint, and the vulnerable banking app.
expected_artifacts.expected_value: asm_findings tagged CortexSimASMFinding for the multi-service exposed host

cleanup.code: rm -rf /tmp/sqlmap-cortexsim /tmp/feroxbuster-asm-004.txt /tmp/gobuster-asm-004.txt /tmp/nikto-asm-004.txt /tmp/whatweb-asm-004.json /tmp/cmseek-asm-004; echo '[CortexSim] SIM-ASM-004 cleanup complete — exposed AWS resources owned by terraform destroy.'

iocs.context: Web technology-fingerprinting tool user-agent observed on inbound requests to the exposed surface.
Directory/content brute-force tool user-agent observed on the inbound content-discovery burst.
SQL-injection probe endpoint on the gocortexbrokenbank banking app exercised by SQLmap.

biocs.name: ASM-004 Web Content-Discovery Path Brute-Force Burst From Single Source
biocs.description: A single source IP issues a high-volume burst of distinct URI paths against the exposed nginx web surface within a short window — the signature of directory/content brute-forcing (Gobuster/Feroxbuster). The world-exposed nginx host is the static ASM finding; this BIOC fires when that surface is actively enumerated, bridging ASM discovery into NGFW/NDR runtime detection.
biocs.logic:
dataset = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw
| filter app = "web-browsing" or dst_port in (80, 443, 9001)
| filter flow_direction = "inbound"
| comp count_distinct(uri_path) as distinct_paths, count() as total_reqs by src_ip, dst_ip
| filter distinct_paths >= 50

biocs.name: ASM-004 SQL-Injection Probe Pattern In Web Request
biocs.description: An inbound web request to the exposed surface (notably the gocortexbrokenbank app on :9001) carries a SQL-injection probe pattern in its URI or payload — the SQLmap detection bridging ASM exposure into runtime exploitation detection.
biocs.logic:
dataset = panw_ngfw_threat_raw
| filter dst_port in (80, 443, 9001)
| filter threat_category = "sql-injection" or uri_path ~= "(?i)(union(\s|\+)+select|or(\s|\+)+1=1|sleep\(|information_schema)"

biocs.name: ASM-004 OS-Command-Injection Probe Pattern In Web Request
biocs.description: An inbound web request to the exposed surface carries an OS-command-injection probe pattern (shell metacharacters / chained commands) in a parameter — the Commix detection completing the injection-probe coverage on the exposed banking app.
biocs.logic:
dataset = panw_ngfw_threat_raw
| filter dst_port in (80, 443, 9001)
| filter threat_category = "code-injection" or uri_path ~= "(?i)(;\s*(cat|id|whoami|uname)|\|\s*(cat|id|whoami)|`.*`|\$\(.*\))"

xql_queries.name: ASM-004 Ground-Truth Manifest Capture Bookkeeping
xql_queries.query:
dataset = asm_findings
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter tags contains "CortexSimASMFinding"
| filter finding_class in ("multi-service-exposed-host", "multiple-exposed-ports")
| comp count_distinct(resource_id) as assets by finding_class
| fields finding_class, assets

xql_queries.name: ASM-004 Web Technology Fingerprint And CMS Enumeration Findings
xql_queries.query:
dataset = asm_findings
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter tags contains "CortexSimASMFinding"
| filter service in ("http", "https") and dst_port in (80, 443, 9001)
| filter detected_technology != null or finding_class = "exposed-web-application"
| comp count_distinct(detected_technology) as fingerprints by resource_id, dst_port
| filter fingerprints >= 1
| fields resource_id, dst_port, fingerprints

xql_queries.name: ASM-004 Content-Discovery Path Fan-Out 1 Src To Many URIs
xql_queries.query:
dataset = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter dst_port in (80, 443, 9001) and flow_direction = "inbound"
| comp count_distinct(uri_path) as distinct_paths, count() as reqs by src_ip, dst_ip
| filter distinct_paths >= 50
| sort desc distinct_paths
| fields src_ip, dst_ip, distinct_paths, reqs

xql_queries.name: ASM-004 Web Vulnerability-Scan Threat-Signature Burst
xql_queries.query:
dataset = panw_ngfw_threat_raw
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter dst_port in (80, 443, 9001)
| filter threat_category in ("vulnerability", "scan", "info-leak")
| comp count() as threat_hits, count_distinct(threat_name) as distinct_sigs by src_ip, dst_ip
| filter threat_hits >= 5
| fields src_ip, dst_ip, threat_hits, distinct_sigs

xql_queries.name: ASM-004 Injection-Probe Threat Signatures Against Banking App
xql_queries.query:
dataset = panw_ngfw_threat_raw
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter dst_port = 9001
| filter threat_category in ("sql-injection", "code-injection")
| comp count() as injection_hits by src_ip, dst_ip, threat_category
| filter injection_hits >= 1
| fields src_ip, dst_ip, threat_category, injection_hits

correlation_rules.name: Exposure Management — Exposed Web Surface Discovered + Actively Enumerated + Injection-Probed
correlation_rules.logic: XQL(ASM-004 Web Technology Fingerprint And CMS Enumeration Findings) AND (XQL(ASM-004 Content-Discovery Path Fan-Out 1 Src To Many URIs) OR XQL(ASM-004 Web Vulnerability-Scan Threat-Signature Burst)) AND (BIOC(ASM-004 SQL-Injection Probe Pattern In Web Request) OR BIOC(ASM-004 OS-Command-Injection Probe Pattern In Web Request) OR XQL(ASM-004 Injection-Probe Threat Signatures Against Banking App)) — stitches the static ASM web-surface discovery with the live NGFW content-discovery + vulnerability-scan + injection-probe detections into one exposure-management incident.

analytics_modules: Cortex ASM / Xpanse — exposed web-application discovery and technology fingerprinting
Cortex XSIAM Analytics — anomalous inbound web content-discovery URI fan-out
Cortex NGFW Threat Prevention — web vulnerability scan + SQL/command-injection signature coverage

products.evidence_query: dataset = asm_findings | filter tags contains "CortexSimASMFinding" | filter service in ("http", "https") | comp count_distinct(resource_id) by finding_class | fields finding_class, resource_id
dataset = panw_ngfw_threat_raw | filter dst_port in (80, 443, 9001) | filter threat_category in ("vulnerability", "sql-injection", "code-injection") | comp count() by threat_name
Correlation CR-ASM-0004 fuses the ASM web-surface discovery finding with the NGFW content-discovery, vulnerability-scan, and injection-probe detections into one exposure-management incident.

threat_scenarios.name: Web-Application Attack-Surface Enumeration & Exploitation Detection via Cortex ASM + NGFW
threat_scenarios.description: Cortex ASM/Xpanse discovers and fingerprints the exposed web application while Cortex NGFW/NDR detects the active content-discovery brute force, web-vulnerability scan, and SQL/command-injection probing, correlating both into a single exposure-management incident.

threat_steps.objective: Cortex ASM discovers and fingerprints the exposed web surface, and the NGFW detects the content-discovery + vulnerability-scan traffic from a single source.
preconditions: asm IaC fixture applied (exposed nginx + gocortexbrokenbank on :9001).
Cortex ASM/Xpanse connected and NGFW/NDR ingesting traffic+threat logs.
Launch consent (simulation_authorized) granted for the dual-use adapters.
steps: Run SIM-ASM-004 fingerprint + content-discovery + vuln-scan steps.
Observe the ASM web-application findings and the NGFW traffic/threat detections.
success_criteria: ASM web technology-fingerprint query returns >= 1 fingerprinted asset.
Content-discovery URI fan-out query returns >= 1 single-source row with distinct_paths >= 50.
Web vulnerability-scan threat-signature query returns >= 1 row.
BIOC `ASM-004 Web Content-Discovery Path Brute-Force Burst From Single Source` fires.

threat_steps.objective: Injection probing against the vulnerable banking app is detected and correlated with the ASM discovery into one exposure incident.
steps: Run the SQLmap + Commix injection-probe steps against :9001.
Observe the injection threat signatures and CR-ASM-0004 escalation.
success_criteria: Injection-probe threat-signature query returns >= 1 row against :9001.
BIOC `ASM-004 SQL-Injection Probe Pattern In Web Request` OR BIOC `ASM-004 OS-Command-Injection Probe Pattern In Web Request` fires.
Correlation CR-ASM-0004 raises a single exposure-management incident stitching discovery + scan + injection.

preventive_controls: Disable nginx directory listing (autoindex off) and remove bait/backup files from the web root.
Place internet-facing web applications behind a WAF / Cortex NGFW with web-vulnerability and injection signatures enabled in blocking mode.
Parameterize all database queries and validate/escape user input to eliminate SQL- and command-injection paths.
Continuously reconcile internet-exposed web assets discovered by Cortex ASM/Xpanse against an approved exposure baseline.
detection_engineering: Alert on single-source URI fan-out exceeding a content-discovery threshold against any internet-facing asset.
Alert on web-vulnerability-scan and injection threat signatures inbound to ASM-discovered exposed services.
Stitch static ASM web-surface findings to NGFW runtime scan/injection telemetry so an actively-probed exposure escalates.
